Agronomic Distinction: Drying vs. Winnowing

1. Drying & Trampling (Awdma): Requires low relative humidity (<65%) and zero rain so straw and glumes fracture cleanly under oxen trampling or beating.

2. Winnowing Separation: Requires steady horizontal wind (typically 2.5–7.5 m/s) to blow light chaff sideways while dense grain kernels drop onto the clean floor.
